heading: One contract per program, fixed at compile time
text:
## One contract per program, fixed at compile time [RTCT.10]

- **A `.ds` file pairs with at most one `.dsrt`.** Two rule files needing similar
  contracts each carry their own.
- **The contract is fixed at compile time and frozen into the
  `.dsc`.** The runtime never adjusts it, and there is no
  renegotiation protocol. Changing a cap means recompiling.

Choosing the headroom values themselves is an engineering judgement
this spec does not make; it governs the contract once chosen.
